issues.description: The required Settings panel and Credits panel states are not shown on desktop or tablet, so the delivered previews do not cover all requested visible states for those form factors.
Tablet only shows the base menu. Required panel states are missing from the supplied tablet evidence despite tablet being a requested target.
The settings modal overhangs the menu frame and creates a cropped, intrusive dark slab across the top area instead of a clean centered panel. This reads as broken overlay composition.
The close button label is visibly clipped to 'los' beside the X, which is a direct text clipping defect on a required control.
The close button label is clipped to 'los' in the credits state as well, repeating the same text clipping defect on a peer control.
The mobile root frame keeps a large empty block beneath the three buttons, making the screen feel unfinished and leaving accidental dead space inside the primary menu surface.
The mobile settings panel is not reflowed for phone: the title, close control, labels, toggle, and slider compete in cramped rows, and the panel width pushes awkwardly against the viewport.

The mobile credits panel does not reflow cleanly. The close control crowds the title and the body text sits in a cramped panel while the underlying menu remains partially visible in a distracting way.
The settings header is misaligned: title sits hard left while the oversized close button intrudes into the heading area, breaking the planned top-right pin and clean header geometry.
The credits header repeats the same misalignment problem, with the close button crowding the title and not reading as a neatly pinned peer action.
The settings close button is styled and sized like a large segmented tab rather than a compact peer close control, making it feel unrelated to the rest of the action kit.
The credits close button has the same unrelated oversized tab treatment, inconsistent with the compact close action specified for both panels.

The menu is functional but visually generic relative to the requested glossy ornamental Aurora treatment. It lacks the title plate character, corner detailing, and premium finish promised by the plan.

The foreground relies on plain rounded rectangles and a simple dark background, so the decorative language is underdeveloped. The requested ornament and title plate richness are absent rather than translated into a cohesive fallback kit.
The modal body leaves a large empty lower section after the two setting rows, which weakens the compact premium feel and makes the panel seem unfinished.

criticalIssues: phone-settings: SettingsPanel overlaps and reads as a broken mobile overlay.
Desktop/tablet evidence is incomplete for required panel states.
repairInstructions: Show all required states on every requested form factor: base menu plus settings and credits panels for desktop, phone, and tablet.
Rebuild the phone settings modal header so the close button is a compact top-right control with no clipped text and clear separation from the title.
Rebuild the phone credits modal header with the same compact close control and enough padding so title and button do not collide.
Reduce mobile root container height or redistribute internal spacing so the main menu frame ends near the button stack instead of leaving a large empty lower cavity.
Create a true mobile modal layout rather than shrinking desktop: stack labels and controls with larger vertical spacing, especially for the volume slider row.
Keep the close controls in the same visual family as the main buttons, but at a smaller compact size appropriate to modal headers.

Strengthen the requested Aurora identity using live-text-compatible fallback decoration: a clearer title plate treatment, restrained corner accents, and richer foreground surface hierarchy without adding new features.
Keep the existing simple icon family if assets are unavailable, but normalize icon/button padding and preserve peer consistency across panel close actions.

preserve: Preserve the centered base menu stack and the current three-action information architecture: Play, Settings, Credits only.
Preserve the readable live text labels and the coherent blue/gold palette direction.
Preserve the existing simple icon family across Play, Settings, Credits, and Close rather than mixing in unrelated icon styles.
Preserve the larger visual emphasis on Play over Settings and Credits.
modify: Modify MainMenuRoot on phone so its height hugs the content stack and removes the empty lower chamber.
Modify SettingsPanel mobile layout to fit fully within safe margins with a compact header, separated rows, and a full-width slider lane.
Modify CreditsPanel mobile layout to use a smaller header close button, better title spacing, and cleaner body padding.
Modify SettingsCloseButton and CreditsCloseButton to compact square-or-short-pill controls with visible X icon and unclipped live text or icon-only treatment if chosen consistently.
Modify TitlePlate fallback styling on all base menu layouts so the heading feels more ceremonial and less like a plain inset rectangle.
Modify panel and root surfaces to add more deliberate depth/highlight hierarchy so the UI feels designed rather than default-rounded.
remove: Remove the oversized tab-like close button treatment from both mobile panels.
Remove the excess blank vertical space inside the phone MainMenuRoot.
Remove the intrusive dark overhang/cropping effect around the top of the phone settings overlay.
add: Add desktop settings-panel and credits-panel previews.
Add tablet settings-panel and credits-panel previews.
Add restrained corner or frame accents to the root and modal surfaces using the same fallback visual language.
Add clearer internal padding rules for mobile headers and rows so titles, buttons, toggles, and sliders do not crowd each other.
